in_telugu.long_meaning: Rāj (రాజ) meaning 'rule' + Indra (ఇంద్ర) meaning 'deity of rain, thunder, and storms'

in_marathi.name: Rajender
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajender हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Raj means 'rule' and ender means 'end'. Together, this name means 'ruler who ends' or 'one who rules over the end'.
